issues.claim: Kraft Lake Insurance Agency, Inc., 5 Marsad Drive, Old Bridge
issues.problem: Ambiguous against the mapper's own exclusion list. Plymouth Rock's listing is "KRAFT LAKE INSURANCE AGENCY, INC. - Jonida Lagji", i.e. the same agent the mapper excluded as a Farmers franchise at the same address. It may be one office counted twice, or a genuinely independent agency that also holds a Farmers book.
issues.fix: Confirm with the NJ DOBI producer/agency lookup whether Kraft Lake is an independent agency; if it is the Farmers-branded office, remove it under the franchise rule.

issues.claim: Roughly twenty entries rest on one statutory-style or user-submitted directory
issues.problem: Entries sourced only from NJ Business Directory (Unity Mortgage, Madison Home Mortgage, Nitech, Gold Group, Anthem Technologies, Retail Business Mgmt Systems, M Rieder Co), city-data business entities (AOK Appraising, Shah Consulting) or D&B (AFOCUS, Monaco Advisory, Intertrade Consultants) have no operating evidence. issues.problem: The cited source is a Monroe NJ category page, which does not itself establish an Old Bridge location; other directories place it at Mapleview Dr, Suite 219B, Old Bridge.
